fields.description: Added to the end of an ephemeral user's name, e.g. "John Doe (consultant)". Leave blank for no suffix.
fields.label: Name Suffix

fields.description: Refuses new access requests and immediately ends every active session on every client.
fields.label: Disable All Access

fields.description: Cap each ephemeral user to one active session at a time. Off by default (Frappe's own multi-session limit applies).
fields.label: Disallow Simultaneous Sessions

fields.description: These users are refused new access requests and have their active sessions immediately ended on every client.
fields.label: Blacklisted Users

fields.description: How long a granted session may stay idle before it's ended. Default 6 hours.
fields.label: Maximum Session Lifetime (seconds)

fields.description: Also log read-only activity, not just changes.
fields.label: Log Reads

fields.description: Logged values larger than this are truncated.
fields.label: Max Logged Value Size (bytes)

fields.description: Logs are kept for this long before being deleted, whether or not they've reached the hub yet.
fields.label: Retention (days)

fields.description: Push activity logs to the hub every hour.
fields.label: Log Sync Enabled

fields.description: Once a log has reached the hub, delete it locally after this many days instead of waiting out the full retention period.
fields.label: Push Grace (days)

fields.description: Changes to these are always logged in full, regardless of the rules above. A Document Type not used on a client site is simply ignored there.
fields.label: Always-Log Doctypes

fields.description: Values every client's access-guard needs to be set up. The per-site transport token is set on each Remote Site.
fields.label: Enrollment Info
